title: Clarified New York Sour
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine the bourbon, lemon, and simple syrup and pour over the milk in a glass container. Let sit for 30 minutes, allowing the milk to curdle. Strain the milk mixture through a coffee filter. If it’s not clear, re-pour through the same filter. To serve, pour the mixture over a large ice cube in a glass. Float with red wine.
